sloka: सखे शृणुष्व सुग्रीव न त्वया ऽहं विनाकृतः ।गच्छेयं देवलोकं वा परमं वा पदं महत् ।। ७.१०८.२६ ॥
transliteration: sakhe śṛṇuṣva sugrīva na tvayā 'haṁ vinākṛtaḥ ।gaccheyaṁ devalokaṁ vā paramaṁ vā padaṁ mahat ।। 7.108.26 ॥

translations.english: "O friend Sugriva, listen," said Rama, "I would not go to the world of gods or to any great supreme abode without you."
